common.error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a minute.
common.unavailable: {product} is temporarily unavailable. Please try again a bit later.
common.rate_limited: You are sending messages too fast. Please wait a minute and try again.
common.private_only: Please write to me in a private chat.

start.welcome_linked: Welcome back, {name}! You are connected to {workspace}. Ask me a work question in plain words, or type /help.
start.welcome_unlinked: Hi! I am the {product} bot. To get started, link your Telegram account: 1. Open {product} → Settings → Integrations. 2. Press Connect Telegram and follow the link back to this chat.
start.welcome_company:
Hi! I am your company's work assistant.

To start, ask your manager for a personal invitation link and open it from this Telegram account.
start.linked: Done! Your Telegram is now linked as {name}. Ask me a question, or type /help to see what I can do.
start.linked_workspace: Done! Your Telegram is now linked as {name} (company {workspace}). Ask me a question, or type /help to see what I can do.
start.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired. Generate a new one in {product} → Settings → Integrations.
start.invalid_company_link: This invitation link is invalid, expired or already used. Ask your manager for a new one.
start.wrong_bot: This invitation link belongs to another company's bot. Open it from the bot your manager sent you.
start.conflict: This Telegram account is already linked to another user in this bot. Unlink it there first with /unlink, then try again.

unlinked.message: Your Telegram account is not linked to {product} yet. Open {product} → Settings → Integrations, press Connect Telegram and follow the link. It takes less than a minute.
unlinked.company: Your Telegram account is not linked to this company yet. Ask your manager for a personal invitation link.

help.title: What I can do
help.intro: Send me a work question in plain words. I answer only from your company's approved documents and show the sources. If the answer is not there, I can pass the question to a manager.

commands.ask_manager: Pass my last question to a manager

assistant.refused_hint: I couldn't find this in your company's approved documents. I can pass the question to a manager.
assistant.empty_answer: I have no answer for that yet.
assistant.unknown_command: I do not know this command. Type /help to see what I can do.
assistant.text_only: I understand text messages only. Please type your question.

actions.expired: This button has expired. Ask your question again.
actions.forbidden: This button belongs to another user.
actions.failed: Could not complete the action. Please try again later.

notify.fallback: You have a new notification in {product}.

notice.acknowledged: Thank you. You can ask your question now.
notice.required: Please read the notice above and press I understand first.

group.private_only: I answer only in private chats, so that answers match each employee's access. Please write to me privately.

history.title: Your last questions
history.empty: You have not asked any questions yet.

incident.no_permission: You cannot report incidents. Please contact your manager.
incident.describe: Describe what happened in one message (client, room, what is damaged).
incident.too_long: The description is too long. Please keep it under {limit} characters.
incident.expired: This incident draft has expired. Start again with /incident.

queue.empty: No open questions are waiting for you.
queue.forbidden: This command is available to managers only.

answer_flow.prompt: Reply to this message with the answer to question {number}.
answer_flow.too_long: The answer is too long. Please keep it under {limit} characters.

ask_manager.sent: Your question was passed to a manager.

privacy.text: Your data in {product} • Your company records the questions you ask here, the answers and the time, so that managers can improve the instructions and answer what the documents do not cover. • Your manager and the company administrators can see your questions, incidents and tasks. Other employees cannot. • Answers come only from your company's approved documents; the bot never decides anything on its own. • Data is kept for the periods set by your company and then deleted automatically. • To get a copy of your data or to have it deleted, ask your manager or the company administrator: they can export or erase it. • /unlink disconnects this Telegram account at any time.

unlink.confirm: Unlink this Telegram account from {workspace}? You will stop receiving answers and notifications here.
unlink.done: This Telegram account is unlinked. To connect again, ask your manager for a new invitation link.
unlink.not_linked: This Telegram account is not linked.

subscription.paused: Answers from the documents are paused for your company right now. You can still report incidents and work with your tasks.

limits.ai_exhausted: Your company has used all questions to the assistant for this month. I can pass your question to a manager.

notify.test_message: Test message The company bot is connected and can deliver notifications.

bot_revoked.title: The company bot stopped working
bot_revoked.text: Telegram rejected the token of @{username}. Reconnect the bot in the {product} settings so employees get answers again.
